scenes.title: shadow-wheel-surface
lines: As the camera moves around the Ferris wheel, identify its structure and its shadow separately. A changed view can require different shadow regions. Apparent softness and which regions were recomputed are different questions. First connect the visible object with the camera movement. Keep the wheel as a reference while separating object movement, viewpoint movement and changed lighting conditions. Similar image changes can alter the required shadow data in different ways.
